headline: Due to sanctions against Russia, Uzbekistan changed the creditor of the project to modernize 95 pumping stations
summary: Uzbekistan changed the financing scheme for a project modernising 95 pumping stations after sanctions against Russia and higher interest rates on loans. Another bank will replace the Russian lender, according to the water minister.
why: Sanctions and rising interest rates can disrupt cross-border project financing, forcing governments to find alternative lenders at different terms. This shapes the cost and timing of public infrastructure projects.
original_headline: Rossiyaga qarshi sanksiyalar sabab O‘zbekiston 95 ta nasos stansiyasini modernizatsiya qilish loyihasi kreditorini o‘zgartirdi
